blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones.
This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from.
In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task → \rightarrow insight mapping.
On challenging tool-calling and coding
datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%.
RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14–31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12–13% when no insight is in context at eval time.
We identify that the key is the task → \rightarrow insight internalization.
To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts.
Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR, Lambert et al. , 2024 ) presents an LLM agent policy with a task and lets the policy attempt to solve it in multiple parallel rollouts. The rewards are then checked for correctness via a verifier (unit tests and final state checks). Successful rollouts receive a positive reward and unsuccessful ones a negative one, for example via GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , improving the agent’s performance over time.
blocks.zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR、Lambert等人,2024年)提出了具有一项任务的LLM代理政策,并让政策尝试在多个平行推出中加以解决。 然后通过核查员(单位测试和最终国家检查)检查奖励是否正确。 成功的推出得到积极的奖励,而失败的推出则得到消极的奖励,例如通过GRPO(Shao等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年b;Yu等人,2026年b),使代理人的业绩随着时间推移有所改善。

blocks.en: This paradigm fails when tasks are so hard that the policy does not produce any successful rollouts in 128 attempts. Starved of learning signal, the training loop does not take off. Further, in self-improvement scenarios such as agentic coding, we assume that the agent is at the frontier; there is no stronger teacher model or golden example solution to learn from. The policy has to explore the problem step by step and internalize findings from its own attempts.
blocks.zh: 如果任务如此艰巨,以致政策未能在128次尝试中成功推出,这种模式就会失败。 渴望学习信号,训练循环不会起飞. 此外,在代理编码等自我改进的情景中,我们假设代理商处于前沿;没有更强大的师范模式或金色的例子解决方案可以学习. 该政策必须一步一步地探讨这一问题,并将自身尝试中的调查结果内部化。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : RLTL;DR rolls out attempts sequentially. When an attempt fails, we let the policy generate its own feedback based on the verifier outcomes, in the form of a high-level TL;DR insight. This insight is fed into next attempts to search for solutions more efficiently, especially on very hard tasks. When the running average success rate of the task is high enough, like in the 6th and 8th rollout, we attempt the task without insights. Besides a GRPO loss on the rollouts, we backpropagate the insights (the bold words on the right) into the model via an SFT loss. Though never predicted at test time, this internalizes and generalizes these higher-level learnings.

blocks.en: We propose two techniques that, in combination, allow breaking through the learning barrier: First, we improve the exploration by moving from parallel i.i.d. rollouts to sequential rollouts. After each attempt, the verifier code is run to check for success, and if the attempt failed, the policy itself is handed the previous attempt and the error message to produce feedback, in the form of a higher-level TL;DR insight like "Remember to paginate search results." . In the next rollout, the policy is conditioned on the task and the previous TL;DR learnings in context. We find that this sequential sampling lifts the exploration phase of RLVR out of the zone of no successful signals, finding at least one solution for Pass@k = = 14–59% of the tasks. However, at test time, when the policy has to provide a solution at the first attempt, without any insights in context, it stays close to its original performance.
blocks.zh: 我们提出两种技术,两者结合,可以突破学习障碍: 首先,我们改进探索,从平行推出到相继推出。 每次尝试后都会运行验证码以检查是否成功,如果尝试失败,则将政策本身传递给之前的尝试和产生反馈的错误消息,其形式为更高层次的TL;DR洞察力,如"记得标注搜索结果". 。 。 。 在接下来的推出中,政策以任务和先前的TL;DR学习为条件. 我们发现,这种连续取样将RLVR的勘探阶段从无成功信号的区域中抬出,至少为Pass@k==14-59%的任务找到一个解决方案. 然而,在试验时,当政策在第一次尝试时必须提供解决办法时,在背景上没有任何见解时,它仍然接近其最初的业绩。

blocks.en: We thus make a minimal second change to the update phase of the model: We activate the backpropagation mask on the self-generated insight tokens that are in the context ( ≈ \approx 17 tokens per insight). This trains a task → \rightarrow something to keep in mind mapping into the policy that, although never generated at test time since insights are inserted in the form of user messages, internalizes the findings and generalizes them to similar problems through sheer smoothness of backpropagation.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们对该模型的更新阶段做了最小的第二次修改: 我们激活在上下文中自我生成的透视符号上的反传播面具(每透视大约17个透视符号). 这需要完成一项任务 ~ 将一些事情切入到政策中去, 尽管在测试时从未出现过,

blocks.en: We find that this breaks through the learning barrier in agentic and coding benchmarks on tasks where the Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) fails for 128 attempts. While GRPO stays flat at 0% to 1%, our RLTL;DR achieves 11–14% Pass@1 (at eval time; without any insights or sequential sampling). We ablate the training and find that the key ingredient is indeed the backpropagation on the task → \rightarrow insight mapping. Even if we turn off the GRPO loss (and thus all backpropagation on tokens from the rollout), the SFT loss on the insight tokens alone achieves almost full performance.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,这突破了在任务上的教学障碍,因为Quen 3.5 9B Thinking(Quen Team, 2026)在128次尝试中失败。 GRPO 保持在 0 到 1% 的水平上, 我们的 RLTL; DR 实现了 11 - 14% Pass@ 1 (在 eval 时间; 没有任何洞察力或顺序抽样 ) 。 我们放弃训练,发现关键成分 确实是任务反向传播 ~ 右侧的洞察力绘图。 即使我们关闭了GRPO损失(因此所有在推出时的标志上反传),光是洞察力标志上的SFT损失就几乎实现了完全的性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
The standard RLVR recipe samples a group of i.i.d. rollouts per task, scores them with a verifier, and updates with a group-relative advantage ( Lambert et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) .
This has a structural failure mode: when every rollout in a group receives the same reward, either all are correct or all are incorrect, the advantage vanishes and the gradient is zero (a phenomenon variously named advantage collapse, the learning cliff, or exploration inefficiency ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Agashe et al., 2026 ) .
When all rollouts are correct, one can apply different loss functions or mitigations such as entropy control, pass@ k k objectives, or difficulty-matched curricula ( Mahrooghi et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . But on the frontier splits we target, success rates are close to zero, deprived of any learnable signal.
blocks.zh:
标准RLVR配方对每件任务进行一组即日推出的样本,以验证器进行评分,并具有集团相对优势的更新(Lambert等人,2024年;Shao等人,2024年;Yu等人,2026年;Liu等人,2025年b).
这有一个结构故障模式:当一个团体的每次推出都得到同样的奖赏时,要么都是正确的,要么都是不正确的,优势就消失了,梯度是零(一个被不同命名的优势崩溃,学习悬崖,或勘探效率低下的现象(夏等人,2026年;阿格拉瓦尔等人,2026年;阿加谢等人,2026年)).
当所有推出都正确时,人们可以应用不同的损失函数或缓解功能,例如:肽控制、通过@kk目标或难度匹配的课程(Mahrooghi等人,2026年;Chen等人,2025年)。 但是,在边界上,我们的目标是,成功率接近零,没有任何可学习的信号。

blocks.en: A growing body of work manufactures at least one success by injecting information the policy will not have at test time. These approaches differ along three axes: the source of the guidance, its explicitness , and the transfer mechanism to ensure the policy still performs when no guidance is available at evaluation time. Sources range from gold solutions and stronger teacher models ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) to the policy’s own failed attempts ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Szot et al., 2026 ) . Explicitness ranges from a verbatim prefix of the reference solution ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) to a single conceptual pointer ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . Transfer mechanisms range from none at all ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , i.e., trusting that improvements under the guided prompt carry over to the bare one, through mixing guided and unguided rollouts within the same group ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Agashe et al., 2026 ) , to importance-sampling corrections that make the gradient unbiased for the unguided objective ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . In this paper, we assume there is no external source of guidance except failed unit tests, i.e., the policy needs to find improvements itself. We further aim to simplify both the insight itself and the transfer mechanism as much as possible. RLTL;DR notes down short self-generated insights during training, and simply backpropagates them to internalize the task → \rightarrow insight mapping and generalize it to similar tasks.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作制造至少一项成功,即通过提供信息,该政策在试验时不会得到。 这些方针在三个方面有所不同:指导的来源、其明确性、以及为确保在评价时没有指导时仍能执行政策的转移机制。 来源包括金溶液和较强的师范模型(张等人,2025年;张等人,2026年b;阿格拉瓦尔等人,2026年),以及政策本身的失败尝试(哈塔米扎德等人,2026年;宋等人,2026年;Szot等人,2026年). 明确性从参考解决方案的逐字记录前缀(Agrawal等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2025年)到单一概念指针(Chen等人,2026年b)不等. 转移机制从零到零(Hatamizadeh等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2025年),即相信在制导的催化下,通过在同一组内混合制导和无制导的推出,将梯度转移至裸体(Chen等人,2026年b;Agashe等人,2026年b),到使梯度不对无制导目标有偏见的重要抽样纠正(Agrawal等人,2026年)。 在本文中,我们假设除了失败的单位测试外,没有外部的指导来源,即政策需要找到改进本身. 我们还力求尽可能简化见解本身和转移机制。 RLTL;DR在训练时记下短篇自创的见解,只是把它们反传到任务内部去 ~\右传的见解映射并概括到类似的任务.

blocks.en: Training a model to behave as if a context was present when it is not is called context distillation ( Askell et al., 2021 ; Snell et al., 2022 ) , recently revisited on-policy ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Closest to us are SDPO ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) and RLTF ( Song et al., 2026 ) , which turn feedback into a self-distillation signal over the rollout. We do not distill the full rollout: we predict the ≈ \approx 17 insight tokens. This relies on the recent finding that models can apply knowledge in a different format than trained on ( Shrivastava et al., 2026 ; Cook et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Nakkiran et al., 2026 ) , going from a short insight to generating a full rollout, enabling to internalize skills and experience ( Lu et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 培训一种模式,使其在不出现上下文时表现得像存在上下文蒸馏(Askell等人,2021年;Snell等人,2022年),最近重新审视了政策(Wang等人,2026年)。 与我们最接近的是SDPO(Hübotter等人,2026年)和RLTF(Song等人,2026年),它们将反馈转化为在推出时的自沉信号. 我们并不精炼出全面推出:我们预测大约17个洞察力符号。 这取决于最近的结论,即模型可以采用与培训不同的格式应用知识(Shrivastava等人,2026年;Cook等人,2026年;Lu等人,2026年a;Nakkiran等人,2026年),从短短的见解走向全面推广,使技能和经验内部化(Lu等人,2026年b; Wu et al., 2026; Chen et al., 2026a).

blocks.en: 3.2 Sequential self-generated insights
blocks.zh: 3.2 连续自发产生的见解

blocks.en:
We introduce RLTL;DR as a new RL training method for solving training tasks that are extremely challenging for the LLM agent, and where neither a stronger teacher agent nor example solutions are available.
On such challenging problems, the LLM agent is unlikely to succeed through random sampling, causing repeated attempts to all receive zero outcome rewards and thus provide no learning signal for the RL training objective in Equation 3.1 ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们采用RLTL;DR作为新的RL培训方法,以解决对LLM代理人来说极具挑战性的培训任务,而对于LLM代理人来说,既无更强大的教师代理人,也无实例解决方案。
在这些具有挑战性的问题上,LLM剂不可能通过随机抽样取得成功,导致一再试图让所有人都得到零结果奖赏,因此无法为Equation 3.1中的RL培训目标提供学习信号(Yue等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
The first component of RLTL;DR addresses this problem by modifying the GRPO sampling phase so that the agent attempts the same task multiple times in a row, conditioned on self-generated insights from previous attempts.
Specifically, after attempting the problem, the agent can reflect on its attempt and use information from the environment observations and failed unit tests (in o T o_{T} ) to determine how to improve the subsequent attempt.
We call this natural language assessment of what should be improved in the next attempt “insight”.
blocks.zh:
RLTL的第一个组件;DR通过修改GRPO采样阶段来解决这一问题,使剂连续多次尝试同样的任务,并以以往尝试中自生的见解为条件.
具体地说,在尝试这一问题之后,该剂可以反思其尝试,并使用来自环境观测和失败的单位测试(o T o_{T})的信息来确定如何改进随后的尝试.
我们称这种自然语言评估在下一次尝试中应该改进什么是“直观的”。

blocks.en:

After it finishes the rollout τ 1 \tau_{1} , if it failed, it self-generates a short insight text f 1 ∼ π θ ( ⋅ | τ 1 ) f_{1}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot|\tau_{1}) .
The insight generation prompt asks the agent to think, summarize, analyze errors, and finally output the insight f i f_{i} as a single-sentence summary of what to improve on the next attempt ( Section A.1 ).
We proceed with generating the next attempt on the task. Whenever at the k k -th attempt ≤ 50 % \leq 50\% of the attempts 1 , … , k − 1 1,\dotsc,k-1 are successful, we insert all insights collected so far. We use the 50 % 50\% boundary to insert insights only on tasks where the agent is struggling, to maintain a goldilocks zone of success rates ( Mahrooghi et al., 2026 ) . Section F.2 shows that RLTL;DR is robust to the choice of the heuristic.

blocks.en: In synchronous rollout collection, one could expect sequential sampling to take K × K\times longer than parallel GRPO sampling, plus the cost of generating the insight. But with asynchronous rollout collection with continuous batching and caching, at K = 8 K=8 we observe the sampling phase to be 4.5 × 4.5\times slower. Since update phases and other fixed costs stay equal, the overall walltime increases by 1.5 × 1.5\times . This is of course not important to begin with in very difficult settings where GRPO simply fails to learn. One could also increase the number of tasks that are rolled out in parallel during rollout collection by K × K\times to alleviate any throughput differences and ensure maximum GPU utilization. We do not do this in this paper in order to give GRPO and RLTL;DR the same amount of data per update phase, for benchmarking fairness.

blocks.en: 3.3 Insight internalization
blocks.zh: 3.3 透视内部化

blocks.en:
While training with sequential insights improves the policy’s ability to explore solutions during training, we find that learning to solve tasks with insights in the context does not directly transfer to solving tasks without insights in the context.
This is significant because, at test time, the agent must succeed in a single attempt. The second component of RLTL;DR internalizes the self-generated insights so that the performance gains from sequential sampling with insights (during training) transfer to operation without insight (during evaluation).
blocks.zh:
虽然有相继性见解的培训提高了政策在培训期间探索解决办法的能力,但我们发现,学习如何以深思熟虑的方式解决任务不会直接转移到没有深思熟虑的情况下解决任务。
这一点很重要,因为在试验时,代理人必须在一次尝试中取得成功。 RLTL的第二个组成部分;DR将自发的见解内化,以便连续取样和(在培训期间)将真知灼见转移到没有真知灼见的操作(在评价期间)的性能收益。

blocks.en:
RLTL;DR overcomes this issue by introducing a new self-distillation objective that trains the model to connect insights directly to the task.
We train the LLM to predict the insights { f i } i = 1 I \{f_{i}\}_{i=1}^{I} it generated in previous rollouts (and has in context later attempts) using the task description g g alone as input π θ ​ ( f 1 , … , f I | g ) \pi_{\theta}(f_{1},\dotsc,f_{I}|g) . This internalizes the knowledge "on this sort of task, keep these sort of things in mind", with generalization to similar tasks happening thanks to semantic smoothness ( Nakkiran et al., 2026 ) . We implement this objective as a standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) loss for next-token prediction.
We denote this SFT loss by ℒ SFT ​ ( θ ) \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}}(\theta) and add it to the GRPO loss to obtain the final RLTL;DR training objective ℒ = ℒ GRPO + λ ​ ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{GRPO}}+\lambda\mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} , where λ \lambda is the insight internalization strength.
We show in Section E.3 that RLTL;DR is robust to the choice of λ \lambda and that λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 is a good default.

blocks.en: 4 RLTL;DR breaks through the learning barrier
blocks.zh: 4 RLTL; DR 突破学习障碍

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. In Appworld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) , the policy has to retrieve information and conduct state-changing actions on a simulated device via multi-step tool-calling. It has 90 train, 57 dev, 168 test-normal, and 417 test-challenge tasks.
Since this dataset is relatively small (especially after filtering them to very hard splits below), we also use a proprietary dataset similar to Appworld, but with 16k train tasks, that we call Synthetic-API (SAPI). For more general coding, we use 2641 Leetcode problems ( Xia et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
数据集. 在Appworld(Trivedi等人,2024年)中,政策必须检索信息,并通过多步工具调用在模拟设备上进行状态变化动作. 它有90辆列车,57辆dev,168辆测试正常,以及417辆测试挑战任务.
由于这个数据集相对较小(特别是在下面过滤到非常硬的分割后),我们也使用类似于Appworld的专有数据集,但有16k列车任务,我们称之为Synthetic-API(SAPI). 对于更一般的编码,我们使用2641个Letcode问题(霞等人,2025年).

blocks.en: The self-improvement scenarios that we aim to study are characterized by tasks that are so hard that the models are struggling to find solutions even with high budgets. To emulate this difficulty, we subsample the above datasets: We use tasks where our policy, Qwen 3.5 9B (with thinking), has no successes in 128 attempts, i.e., Pass@128=0. This filters down SAPI to 458 tasks. For the smaller Appworld dataset, we combine the train, dev, and test-normal splits (and keep test-challenge unseen), leaving 34 tasks after filtering to the Pass@128=0 set. Leetcode has 123 remaining tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们打算研究的自我改进设想的特点是任务艰巨,以至于即使有高预算,这些模型也难以找到解决办法。 为了效仿这一困难,我们对上述数据集进行子样本: 我们利用我们的政策Quen 3.5 9B(有思维)在128次尝试中没有成功的任务,即Pass@128=0. 这可以将SAPI过滤到458项任务. 对于较小的Appworld数据集,我们合并了列车,dev,和测试-正常的拆分(并保持测试-挑战隐蔽),过滤到Pass@128=0集后留下了34项任务. Leetcode还有123项剩余任务.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare RLTL;DR to three baselines. RLTF-SD ( Song et al., 2026 ) is a recent method, similar in kind. It uses a Self Distillation loss to train a rollout generated with insight into the policy without insight. For fairness, we provide it with the same sequential rollouts and insight generation strategies as for our method. Second, we compare against Strategy-guided Exploration (SGE, Szot et al. , 2026 ). This aims to explore more solutions by prepending summaries of previous failed or successful attempts on a task (though without insights on what went wrong), and prompting the model to try something else. Finally, we compare against a standard GRPO baseline. We tune our GRPO baseline extensively. Our Qwen 3.5 9B GRPO baseline trained only on Appworld-train achieves 72.2% Pass@1 on test-challenge. As of the release of this paper, the best agent on the official Appworld leaderboard is a frontier model in a custom harness, at 73.4 Pass@1.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较RLTL;DR与三个基线. RLTF-SD(Song et al., 2026)是一种近代方法,类似实物. 它利用自我消化损失来训练一个用洞察力对政策进行洞察的推出。 为了公平起见,我们向它提供与我们的方法相同的连续展开和洞察力生成战略。 第二,我们与战略指导的勘探相比较(SGE, Szot等人,2026年)。 其目的是探讨更多的解决办法,预先总结以往在一项任务上失败或成功的尝试(尽管没有深入了解出错之处),并促使模型尝试其他方法。 最后,我们比较了GPRO标准基线。 我们广泛调整我们的GPRO基线。 我们的Quen 3.5 9B GRPO基线只受过Appworld-train训练,在测试-挑战上达到72.2%的Pass@1。 截至本文发布,官方Appworld领导板上最好的代理是定制吊带中的前沿模型,为73.4 Pass@1.

blocks.en: Deconfounded evaluation. Since some of the rollouts are conditioned on insights in their context during training, we deconfound our metrics. Our curves and metrics, both during train and eval, always show the performance on rollouts without insight in context (and are macro-averaged across all tasks, see Appendix D ). This allows to compare fairly, treating insight only as a train aid.
blocks.zh: 破解评价. 由于在培训期间,有些课程的推出取决于对课程背景的洞察力,我们解析了我们的衡量标准。 我们的曲线和度量衡,无论是在列车还是电华期间,总是在不透视背景的情况下展示推出时的表现(并对所有任务进行宏观平均,见附录D)。 这样可以进行公平的比较,把洞察力仅仅当作火车援助。

blocks.en: We use the official heldout sets for evaluation, without filtering for hard tasks, to show ensure the policies do not degradate outside hard tasks. Appworld test-challenge has 417 new tasks on both the seven seen and two new apps. SAPI has 1624 tasks on 4 unseen apps. Leetcode has 228 unseen problems. We take multiple attempts to achieve 2k rollouts for each dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用正式的搁置来评估,而不过滤困难的任务,以确保政策不会在困难任务之外贬低。 Appworld test-challenge在7个看到和2个新应用上都有417个新任务. SAPI在4个看不见的应用程序上有1624个任务. Leetcode有228个隐形问题. 我们进行了多次尝试 实现2k推出每个数据集。

Although it conditions on previous attempts and it is highlighted that they failed, it does not reflect on failed unit tests. We observe that this misleads next rollouts (reproducing Cheng et al. (2026) , see also Section 6 ).

blocks.en: RLTL;DR, on the other hand, breaks through the learning barrier and reaches a Pass@1 of 12–13%. As can be seen from the SAPI curve before 170k steps, and the heldout splits in Table 1 , the internalization generalizes insights to new tasks. We do not see this on Leetcode. Both RLTL;DR and RLTF-SD find solutions during training (GRPO does not) but seem to overfit in the process. We discuss this in Section 7 . When including rollouts with insights in context, train-time Pass@1 is 14–31%, and train-time Pass@k is 14–59%, demonstrating how RLTL;DR finds learning signals on previously impossible tasks.
blocks.zh: RLTL;DR则突破学习障碍,达到12-13%的Pass@1。 从170k步骤前的SAPI曲线中可以看出,而挂断在表1中分裂,内化将洞察力概括为新任务. 我们看不到这个在Letcode上。 RLTL;DR和RLTF-SD都在培训期间找到解决方案(GPRO没有),但似乎在这个过程中过于适合. 我们在第7节中讨论这个问题。 火车时间传递@1为14-31%, 火车时间传递@k为14-59%,

blocks.en: RLTF-SD also learns. We refrain from claims on either approach outperforming. Instead, we see RLTL;DR and RLTF-SD as two promising approaches of acquiring off-policy knowledge (the same knowledge, since in our experiments they both use our sequential sampling and insight generation pipeline). But while RLTF-SD learns by backpropagating examples, RLTL;DR learns from the high-level insight. These two complementary backpropagation signals can be combined by simply changing the gradient mask in RLTF-SD. We observe performance gains with this in Section E.9 .
blocks.zh: RLTF-SD也学习. 我们避免对两种做法提出优于业绩的要求。 相反,我们认为RLTL;DR和RLTF-SD是获取政策外知识的两种有希望的办法(同样的知识,因为在我们的实验中,它们都使用我们的连续取样和洞察力生成管道)。 但是,虽然RLTF-SD通过背传实例来学习,但RLTL;DR则从高层次的洞察力中学习. 这两个互补的反扩散信号可以通过简单地改变RLTF-SD中的梯度罩来组合. 在E.9节中,我们看到了这方面的业绩成果。

blocks.en: We also train on a slightly easier split of Synthetic API with a baseline Pass@1 = = 4% in Section E.6 , with equivalent observations. On the unfiltered datasets in Section E.7 , where only ≤ \leq 3–5% of tasks are frontier-difficult, GRPO is able to learn, and RLTL;DR neither helps nor hurts performance (except Leetcode). We thus see RLTL;DR as a method for training on challenging tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们还在E.6节中用基线通道@1==4%进行略为容易的合成API分拆训练,并有相当的观察. 在E.7节未过滤的数据集上,只有\\leq 3–5%的任务有前沿困难,GRPO能够学习,RLTL;DR既无帮助也无伤害性能(Letcode除外). 因此,我们将RLTL;DR视为培训挑战性任务的方法。

blocks.en: TL;DR: RLTL;DR breaks through the learning barrier that GRPO faces on Pass@128=0 tasks, reaching 12-13% Pass@1 (evaluated without insights in context or sequential attempts).
blocks.zh: TL; DR: RLTL; DR突破了GRPO在Pass@128=0任务上面临的学习障碍,达到12-13%Pass@1(在上下文或顺序尝试中没有洞察力评价).

blocks.en: 5 Reducing to the secret sauce: From RLTL;DR to SFTL;DR
blocks.zh: 页:1 减到秘密酱油:从RLTL;DR到SFTL;DR

blocks.en: In the development of RLTL;DR, internalizing the insight via ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} was the switch that enabled self-improvement on very hard tasks. In this section, we reduce to only ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} , and make the perhaps surprising finding that we can learn only from insights, without full rollouts.
blocks.zh: 在 RLTL; DR 的开发中,通过 L SFT\ mathcal{L}_{\Text{SFT} 将洞察力内部化是一个开关, 使得在非常艰巨的任务上能够自我改进. 在此节中, 我们只减少为 L SFT \ mathcal{L}_{\Text{SFT}}}, 并做出也许令人惊讶的发现,

blocks.en: 5.1 Experiment setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We dedicate the remainder of this paper to SAPI, due to its sheer size. We use a split containing the 458 frontier-difficult tasks, plus 184 very difficult tasks as explained in Section E.6 . Qwen 3.5 9B achieves 4% Pass@1 on this split. The 642 tasks are split into 256 eval and 386 train tasks. GRPO training still fails, while RLTL;DR achieves 21.5% Pass@1.
blocks.zh: 我们把本文的其余部分献给SAPI,因为其规模很大。 正如E.6节所解释的那样,我们使用包含458项边疆困难任务的分成法,加上184项非常困难的任务。 Quen 3.5 9B在此分割时实现4% Pass@1. 642任务分为256 eval任务和386 列车任务. GRPO 培训仍然失败, 而 RLTL; DR 实现 21.5% pass@1.

blocks.en: Starting with the standard RLTL;DR run (GRPO loss and SFT loss on insight with strength λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 ), we first reduce and then fully deactivate λ \lambda . Then, on the contrary, we deactivate the GRPO loss and train only with the SFT loss. These trainings are all online, so rollouts are collected as the policy improves.
blocks.zh: 从标准的 RLTL; DR 运行开始(GRPO 丢失和 SFT 丢失的透视力 QQ = 0.5\lambda = 0.5),我们首先减少,然后完全关闭 QQ\lambda 。 恰恰相反,我们取消了GRPO的损失, 训练只与SFT的损失。 这些培训都是在线的,因此随着政策的改进,推广工作被收集起来.

blocks.en: We also train on all successful rollouts collected throughout the standard RLTL;DR run via offline SFT. These SFT runs use a log likelihood loss on the agent actions in the rollouts, with insights in the contexts but without SFT loss on the insights, over 10 epochs. Besides Pass@1 on train and heldout tasks, we track the number of tokens we backpropagate on, as well as the number of tokens we need to forward calculate to generate the context KV caches. We train on different amounts of SFT data to be able to compute-match the SFTL;DR results.
blocks.zh: 我们还对通过标准RLTL收集的所有成功推出项目进行培训;DR通过离线SFT运行。 这些SFT运行在推出过程中使用了代理动作的日志概率损失,对背景有洞察力,但对洞察力没有SFT损失,超过10个世纪. 除了在列车和挂载任务上的 Pass@ 1, 我们跟踪我们后置的符号数, 以及我们需要转发的符号数 来生成上下文 KV 缓存 。 我们训练不同数量的SFT数据,以便能够计算SFTL;DR结果.

blocks.en: In the runs named SFTL;DR, we use the same rollouts but only apply the SFT loss on the insight tokens π θ ​ ( f 1 , … , f I | g ) \pi_{\theta}(f_{1},\dots,f_{I}|g) , without backpropagating (or even forward calculating) the actual rollouts, which would come autoregressively after the insight. The standard SFTL;DR setup backpropagates on all insights in each rollout, possibly multiple times (insights appear in multiple rollouts per task, and in multiple combinations). In SFTL;DR-deduplicated, we further simplify this training. We create unique tuples ( g , f ) (g,f) of the insights per task, 4k in total, and then train π θ ​ ( f | g ) \pi_{\theta}(f|g) one-by-one. This resembles a training where we only train "on this task, remember this insight".
blocks.zh: 在名为SFTL;DR的运行中,我们使用同样的推出方式,但只将SFT损失应用在透视符号上 π(f 1,...,f I |  g g)\pi_{\theta}(f_{1},\dots,f_{I}|g),没有背传(甚至向前计算)实际推出,在透视之后会自动出现. 标准SFTL;DR在每次推出时都会在所有的洞见上设置后传,可能多次出现(每个任务在多个推出中出现透视,以及多个组合). 在SFTL;DR-dedreducted中,我们进一步简化了这种训练. 我们创造独特的Tuples(g, f) (g, f) 对每个任务的洞察力, 总共4k, 然后训练\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\(f\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 这就像一个训练 我们只训练"关于这个任务,记住这个洞察力"。

blocks.en: 5.2 Reducing RLTL;DR to just SFTL;DR
blocks.zh: 5.2 将RLTL;DR只减少SFTL;DR

blocks.en: Table 2 : We find that ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} drives most performance, on the SAPI frontier difficulty split separated into train and heldout eval tasks. The first four runs are RLTL;DR ablations, showing that the SFT loss on insights is the driving factor. The next are normal SFT train runs on rollouts collected in the first RLTL;DR run. Most rollouts have insight in context, but it is not backpropagated on. The last group of experiments is the simplified SFTL;DR training that only backpropagates on the insights, not the rollouts. Forward tokens and backward tokens concern the logits that need to be computed in the update phase. Rollout collection is another 1B tokens. All results are ± 0.6 % \pm 0.6\% standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 表2:我们发现,L SFT \ mathcal{L}_{\Text{SFT}}}驱动大部分性能,在SAPI边境困难中,分离成列车和被扣留的eval任务. 前四跑是RLTL;DR bloods,显示SFT在洞察力上的损失是驱动因素. 接下来是普通的SFT列车运行于第一台RLTL;DR运行中收集的延伸. 多数推广活动对背景有洞察力,但并没有反向传播。 最后一组实验是简化的SFTL;DR训练,它只在洞察力上反射,而不是展开. 前进令牌和后退令牌涉及更新阶段需要计算的对数。 推出收藏是另一个1B符号. 所有结果为±0.6%\pm 0.6+%标准偏差.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the Pass@1 on the train and unseen eval tasks, both evaluated without insight in context or sequential sampling. The first four runs show that ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} is the driving factor in RLTL;DR. Reducing its mixture weight from λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 to λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 or 0 0 severly impacts both train and eval performance (increasing it beyond λ > 0.5 \lambda>0.5 did not further improve it). While the model might be learning how to solve tasks given insight, it does not internalize the insight itself to one-shot solve tasks once insight is not available in context. In fact, entirely removing the GRPO loss and only utilizing the SFT loss on insight tokens (but still in the RL setup of interleaved rollout and update phases) recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR. Nevertheless, the additional learning signal from the full rollouts lets runs with non-zero GRPO loss converge faster ( Section E.3 ), so we recommend leaving it activated.
blocks.zh: 表2显示列车上的Pass@1和隐形的eval任务,两者在上下文或顺序抽样中均没有洞察力。 前四次运行显示,L SFT \ mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\Text{SFT}}在RLTL;DR中是驱动因子. 将混合物重量从 = 0.5\ lambda= 0.5降至 = 0.01\ lambda= 0.01 或 0 分别影响火车和 eval 性能(将其增加至  > 0.5\lambda > 0.5之外,没有进一步改善)。 虽然模型可能正在学习如何解决给人以洞察力的任务,但是,在无法从上下文中找到洞察力时,它并没有将洞察力本身内化为一弹即决的任务。 事实上,完全去除GRPO损失,只利用SFT损失在透视符上(但仍处于RL设置的互开和更新阶段),几乎恢复了RLTL的全部性能;DR. 尽管如此,全面推出后的额外学习信号使得非零GRPO损失的运行速度更快(E.3节),因此我们建议让它启动。

blocks.en: Classical SFT on the rollouts collected during the RLTL;DR is slightly above RLTL;DR’s performance, though still close to standard deviation. Indeed, we can reduce the number of train rollouts from 3.5k to 100 without losing much performance, as performance scales sub-linearly with the amount of input. This gives a compute-matched baseline to compare to SFTL;DR.
blocks.zh: 在RLTL期间收集的推出时的经典SFT;DR略高于RLTL;DR的性能虽然仍然接近标准偏差. 事实上,我们可以将火车的开行次数从3.5k减少到100,而不会损失很多性能,因为性能会随着投入量而分线进行。 这给出了一个与SFTL;DR作比较的计算基准.

blocks.en:
Interestingly, simply training on (task, insight) tuples in SFTL;DR, without ever seeing the insight "in action" in a rollout, like above almost reaches SFT and RLTL;DR performance on full rollouts. This might be the most striking result: The model is able to internalize and generalize the knowledge given in an entirely different format from how it will have to put it into code at evaluation time.
We discuss this finding in the light of recent findings on the surprising smoothness of training of large language models in Section 7.1 .
blocks.zh:
有趣的是,仅仅在SFTL(任务,洞察力)Tuples(任务,洞察力)上进行培训;DR,从未在推出时看到"在行动"的洞察力,就像上面几乎达到SFT和RLTL;DR在全面推出时的表现. 这可能是最显著的结果: 该模型能够将以完全不同的格式提供的知识内部化和概括化,这与在评价时如何将知识输入代码是完全不同的。
我们参照最近关于第7.1节大型语文模式培训令人惊讶的顺利性的调查结果讨论这一结论。

blocks.en: A final remark is that training only on (task, one-sentence insight) tuples also reduces the train compute. Its 4.6M forward (context) and 68k backwards (insight) tokens approach the performance of SFT on 100 rollouts with 9.5M forward and 217k backward tokens, and SFT on 3.5k rollouts with 400M forward and 6.6M backward tokens. We underline that this is purely a reduction in policy update compute. Full rollouts still need to be collected in order to generate the insights, which is the largest block of about ≈ \approx 1B tokens in all approaches.
blocks.zh: 最后一点是,只接受(任务、一罪不二审)的训练也会减少列车的计算。 它的4.6M前(context)和68k后(insight)符号接近SFT在100推出时的性能有9.5M前和217k后方符号,SFT则在3.5k推出时有400M前和6.6M后方符号. 我们强调,这纯粹是减少政策更新的计算。 为了产生洞察力,仍然需要收集全部的展开,这是所有方法中大约 \\\ 1B 符号的最大块。

blocks.en: TL;DR: LLMs can be trained simply via a ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} loss on (task, one-sentence insight) tuples, without backpropagating on any rollouts, to internalize and generalize high-level knowledge.
blocks.zh: TL; DR: LLMs可以简单地通过L SFT\mathcal{L}_{\Text{SFT}}在(任务,一刑洞察力)Tuple上丢失,而不对任何推出进行反宣传,以内化和概括高级知识.

blocks.en: 6 What makes for good insights?
blocks.zh: 6个 凭什么有好见解?

blocks.en: The insight we provide the model is short and procedural: typically, a single sentence (17 words on average), like “You need to mark the article as read instead of just viewing it” , see Appendix C . Crucially, the insight need not be too specific: as we show below, this level of abstraction is key for reaching good learning signal. We ablate multiple insight design choices on the SAPI-frontier split: how detailed it is, how it is generated, and how many iterations of insight are sequentially attached.
blocks.zh: 我们提供的见解是简短的和程序性的:一般是单句(平均为17个字),如“你需要将文章标为已读,而不是只看它”,见附录C。 关键是,洞察力不必过于具体:如下文所示,这种抽象程度是达到良好的学习信号的关键. 我们放弃了对SAPI-Frontier拆分的多重洞察力设计选择:它有多详细,如何生成,以及连续附着了多少次洞察力的迭代.

blocks.en: Insight content. We vary how detailed the insights are that are placed into the agent’s context. Instead of the single-sentence TL;DR, we provide a full diagnostic paragraph on why the attempt failed, optionally a summary of the attempt preceding the diagnostic paragraph, or both plus a proposed code correction. These artifacts are already generated in the main method as a byproduct when giving a TL;DR insight (we just see them as autoregressive generation aids and drop everything except the TL;DR insight), so they give the same hint, just in different level of detail.
blocks.zh: 透视内容. 我们不尽相同。 与单一判决的TL;DR不同,我们提供了一个关于尝试失败原因的完整诊断段落,在诊断段落之前可以选择对尝试的总结,或者两者都加上一个拟议的代码校正. 这些文物在给出TL;DR的洞察力(我们只是把它们看成是自动生成辅助剂,除了TL;DR洞察力之外,放下一切)时,在主要方法中已经作为副产品产生出来,所以它们给出了相同的提示,只是不同程度的细节.

blocks.en: Insight generator. First, we degrade the insights by turning off thinking during insight generation, or by not showing failed unit tests. Next, we improve insights by using a separate, more capable teacher model, GLM 5.2 ( GLM-5-Team, 2026 ) , in both thinking and non-thinking modes.
blocks.zh: 透视发电机. 首先,我们通过在产生洞察力时关闭思维,或者不显示失败的单位测试来降低洞察力. 接下来,我们通过在思考和非思考模式中使用单独的、更能胜任的教师模式GLM 5.2(GLM-5-Team,2026年)来提高洞察力.

blocks.en: Amount of insight. We set the maximum number of insights in the context to 1, 2, 4, and 8, instead of the default 16. Note that we always use (and backpropagate) the most recent insight.
blocks.zh: 识量. 我们设定了上下文中的最大洞见数为1、2、4和8,而不是默认的16。 请注意,我们总是使用(和后助门)最新的见解。

blocks.en:
We train and evaluate like in Section 5 . Table 3 shows that replacing the TL;DR format with more detailed insights hurts performance: train Pass@1 reduces from 21.4 21.4 to 20.3 20.3 with the diagnostic paragraph, and more sharply to 13.8 13.8 when the summary is added, and to 15.6 15.6 when the corrected code is added as well.
This drop is not because detailed insights are less useful in context: As everywhere in this paper, the numbers above measure performance without insights in context. When we instead measure Pass@1 with insights in context, summary + diagnostic paragraph yields the largest benefit of any configuration tested, adding + 41.1 % +41.1\% over the Pass@1 of unaided rollouts, against + 36.0 % +36.0\% for TL;DR. This suggests that detailed hints help the agent solve the task at hand but do not provide a learning signal that can be internalized for the unaided setup, or generalized to other tasks, while TL;DR insights state reusable rules. This is in line with expectations in literature, for two reasons: First, detailed insights might include session-specific details that are hard to predict from the goal alone, like IDs (see Lu et al. (2026a) and Section C.2 ), preventing internalization due to label noise. Second, even when a detailed insight can be internalized, it may be too specific to transfer to other tasks, as discussed by Xia et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh:
我们像第5节那样训练和评价 表3显示,用更详尽的见解取代TL;DR格式会损害性能:列车Pass@1与诊断段从21.4 21.4 减少到20.3 20.3,在增加摘要时更尖锐地减少到13.8 13.8,在增加更正代码时也减少到15.6 15.6。
减少并非因为详细的见解在下文中用处不大: 与本文的任何地方一样,上述数字是在没有深入了解的情况下衡量业绩的。 当我们用上下文来衡量 Pass@1时,简略+诊断段落将产生任何测试配置的最大好处,在无援助推出的 Pass@1上加上+41.1%+41.1++++================================================================================================================================================================================================================= 这表明详细的提示可以帮助代理解决手头的任务,但不能提供可以内化为无辅助设置的学习信号,或者被泛化为其他任务,而TL;DR的洞察力则有可重复使用的规则. 这符合文献中的期望,原因有两个: 首先,详细的见解可能包括仅从目标中难以预测的具体会话细节,如IDs(见Lu et al. (2026a)和C.2节),防止因标签噪声而内部化. 第二,即使详细的洞察力可以内化,但可能过于具体,转移到其他任务,如霞等人(2026年)所讨论的.

blocks.en: Changing who generates the TL;DR insight matters less than what information the generator has. A stronger teacher gives a modest gain. With 16 insights, GLM 5.2 with thinking reaches 24.5 24.5 vs. 21.4 21.4 for the student. With a single insight, the gap grows to about 5 5 points ( 26.2 26.2 vs. 21.4 21.4 ). Thinking makes little difference for either generator, it slightly increases the train Pass@1 and yet slightly decreases the evaluation Pass@1. Some of these differences are within run-to-run noise: we read them as trends rather than a clear ranking. The same conclusion applies to our analysis of the number of insights (see Appendix E.8 for a complementary study of this design choice at inference time). In contrast, removing access to the failed unit tests has a large effect: the student fails to extract useful insights, and Pass@1 drops to 3.4 3.4 . What matters most is thus whether the insight correctly identifies the failure. RLTL;DR seems to handle insight well whether it is generated on- or off-policy (or potentially by humans). In practice, any reasonably capable insight generator works, which can be achieved even with a small model if given access to privileged information, or by stronger generators when available.
blocks.zh: 改变谁生成 TL; DR 洞察力比生成者拥有的信息要小 。 更强的老师会得到一点好处 有16种见解,GLM 5.2具有思维能力,为学生达到24.5 24.5对21.4 21.4. 有了单一的洞察力,差距就会扩大至约5个5点(26.226.2对21.421.4. 思考对于两个发电机都没有什么区别,它略微增加了列车通道@1,但略微减少了评价通道@1. 其中一些差异存在于运行中的噪声中:我们把它们看成是趋势而不是明确的排名. 同样的结论也适用于我们对见解数目的分析(关于推断时对这一设计选择的补充研究,见附录E.8)。 相比之下,取消访问失败的单位测试有较大效果:学生未能提取有用的见解,Pass@1降至3.43.4. 因此,最重要的是洞察力是否正确识别失败。 RLTL;DR似乎很好地处理了无论是在政策上还是政策外(或可能是人类)产生的洞察力. 在实践中,任何具有合理能力的能见度的生成器都能够工作,即使有小模型,只要能够获得特权信息,也可以使用更强大的生成器。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Pass@1 (without insight in context) after training with different forms of insight. n fb n_{\text{fb}} is the maximum number of insights placed in the context.
blocks.zh: 表3:经过不同形式的深入培训后,通过@1(没有内在的洞察力)。 n fb n_{\text{fb}}}是放在上下文中的最大见解数量.

blocks.en: TL;DR: Insights can be generated by any model and should use any privileged information that makes them accurate. But they should remain broad enough to generalize to other tasks.
blocks.zh: TL; DR:透视可以通过任何模型生成,应当使用任何使其准确的特权信息. 但是,它们应该保持足够广泛,以便概括到其他任务。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: 7.1 The surprising learning only from (task, insight) tuples
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 只从(任务、洞察力)拖累中学习

blocks.en: The "secret sauce" of our approach seems to be training on the insight tokens given only the task description. Although these tokens are never produced at eval time, this training seems to be sufficient to backpropagate the higher-level findings of the insights into the model parameters and implicitly apply them during rollout generation.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法的“秘密酱油” 似乎是在训练 只有任务描述的洞察力符号。 虽然这些代号从未在eval时间产生,但这种培训似乎足以支持对模型参数的更高层次的见解结论,并隐含地在推出时加以应用。

blocks.en: There are three recent works that observe similar phenomena. ECHO ( Shrivastava et al., 2026 ) train an agentic policy that interacts with a terminal, and during the update phase also backpropagate on the terminal outputs. They find that this improves the general knowledge of the policy about the terminal. Like in our setup, these tokens are inside user messages, not in agent messages, and hence the knowledge is just internalized but never explicitly generated. Lu et al. (2026a) make a similar finding in (text-based) embodied agent and search tasks. Cook et al. (2026) first train the model on code documentations and then test its ability to write code for new tasks. They observe that this knowledge transfers between the two formats, like in our jump from task → \rightarrow insight backpropagation to task → \rightarrow rollout generation. Earlier, Hsieh et al. (2023) have noted that backpropagating think traces into LLMs, even if the LLM is used without think traces at test time, improves performance.
blocks.zh: 最近有三部作品观测到类似现象. ECHO(Shrivastava等人,2026年)训练一种与终端交互的代理政策,在更新阶段,也会对终端输出进行后置. 他们发现,这提高了关于终点站政策的一般知识。 和我们的设定一样,这些代号是在用户信息内部,而不是在代理信息中,因此,知识只是内部化的,但从未明确生成. Lu等人(2026年a)在(基于文本的)包含的代理和搜索任务中做出了类似的发现. 库克等人. (2026)首先在代码文档上培训模型,然后测试其为新任务编写代码的能力. 他们观察到,这种知识在两种形式之间转移,就像我们从任务中跳跃 ~ 右侧的洞察力反向传播 ~ 右侧的展开生成。 早些时候,Hsieh等人(2023年)曾指出,反向传播思维痕迹进入LLM,即使LLM在测试时使用时没有思维痕迹,也会提高性能.

blocks.en: The generalization dynamics that drive this transfer are currently unknown. We attribute the effectiveness of (task, insight) training to smoothness during the backpropagation. Our best understanding is that during backpropagation, LLMs act as semantic similarity machines, so that parameters for not just the literal task but semantically similar tasks and different output formats are updated, thanks to having trained on vast amounts of similar tasks and smoothing out their semantic similarities ( Nakkiran et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 推动这种转移的通俗化动态目前尚不得而知. 我们把(任务、洞察力)培训的有效性归结为后向传播过程中的平稳性。 我们的最好理解是,在反向传播过程中,LLMS起到语义相似的机器作用,因此,由于对大量类似任务进行了培训并平滑了它们的语义相似性(Nakkiran等人,2026年),因此不仅对字面任务,而且对类似任务和不同输出格式的参数进行了更新.

blocks.en: 7.2 Limits of (task, insight) learning
blocks.zh: 7.2 学习的限度(任务、见解)

blocks.en: Based on this understanding, we expect that compacted (task, insight) training will not work in tasks that are overly specific and share little common rules. For example, if a mathematical proof requires finding a very specific trick, the sequential sampling might help explore this more quickly, but the (task, insight) training will not help generalize to other tasks. We suspect the similar effect to hold for our Leetcode results. We also hypothesize that (task, insight) training is an emergent capability that works only if the model has already been pretrained on enough full rollouts, in order to have a sufficiently smooth network. Last, we believe that there might be some domains in which finding a good insight requires the same capability level as generating a valid solution in the first place. While we did not observe this in the tool calling and coding benchmarks in this paper (potentially because we have the privileged information of the verifier), it might become problematic in domains like automated scientific research. There, internalizing insight might still work as good as learning from full rollouts, but coming up with the insight might be too hard for our sequential rollout strategy.
blocks.zh: 基于这一理解,我们期望,紧凑的(任务、洞察力)培训将无法完成过于具体和几乎没有共同规则的任务。 例如,如果数学证明需要找到一个非常具体的诡计,相继采样可能有助于更迅速地探索这一点,但(任务,洞察力)训练不会帮助概括到其他任务. 我们怀疑我们的Letcode结果也有类似效果。 我们还假设,(任务、洞察力)培训是一种新兴能力,只有在模型已经经过充分全面推出的预先培训,才能发挥作用,以便有一个足够平稳的网络。 最后,我们认为,在某些领域,找到良好的见解需要的能力水平与产生有效解决办法的能力水平相同。 虽然我们在本文件的调用和编码基准工具中没有注意到这一点(可能是因为我们掌握了核查者的特权信息),但在诸如自动科学研究等领域可能会出现问题。 在那里,内在化的洞察力可能仍然和从全面推广中学习一样有效,但是要提出洞察力对于我们相继推出的战略来说可能太困难了。

blocks.en: We do not expect, however, that scaling to larger models would make insight-based learning less effective. On the contrary, we believe that the smoothness that enables learning and generalization from insight is likely to be ever larger in larger models. We also believe that larger models are better insight generators, and potentially able to find errors in a previous attempt even when the verifier outcomes are not revealed to them. We encourage to test this hypothesis in future works.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们并不期望,扩大规模,采用更大的模式,将使基于洞察力的学习效果降低。 相反,我们认为,在更大的模型中,能够从洞察力中学习和概括的光滑度可能更大。 我们还认为,更大的模型是更好的洞察力生成器,即使核查结果没有向它们透露,也可能在以前的尝试中找到错误。 我们鼓励在今后的工作中检验这一假设。

blocks.en: 7.3 Source and quality of insight
blocks.zh: 7.3 见解的来源和质量

blocks.en: In Section 6 , we find that performance depends on the insight. Our setup uses the small student model as its own insight generator, but gives access to the verifier code and outcomes as priviledged information. If this is revoked, the insight becomes too low-quality to learn from. Equivalently, larger teacher models generate insight that increases performance further. In preliminary work, we also experimented with not having any LLM generated insight, but just unit tests that output instructive strings, which also gives some performance.
blocks.zh: 第6节,我们发现业绩取决于见解。 我们的设置使用小学生模型作为自己的洞察力生成器,但允许使用校验码和结果作为privelized information. 如果这被取消,洞察力就会变得太低,无法从中学习. 同样,较大的教师模式产生洞察力,进一步提高绩效。 在初步工作方面,我们还试验了没有LLM产生任何的洞察力,而只是单元测试输出有启发性的弦,这也提供了一些性能.

blocks.en: Our best understanding is that the source of the insight does not matter and can be left as a pragmatic choice. It only matters whether an insight is helpful enough to increase the Pass@k in the next rollout, while being generic enough to transfer to other tasks. We discuss in Section D.2 that if one does not train insight into the model via an SFT loss but, e.g., a GRPO loss, then other metrics about the insight can become important (such as being not too revealing to get mixed groups of rollouts).
blocks.zh: 我们最好的理解是,洞察力的来源并不重要,可以作为务实的选择。 洞察力是否足以在下次推出时增加Pass@k,而通用性是否足以转移至其他任务,这一点才重要。 我们在D.2节中讨论,如果人们不通过SFT损失来培养对模型的洞察力,但例如,GRPO损失,那么其他关于洞察力的衡量标准就会变得重要(例如不会太显眼而导致混合的推出)。

blocks.en: 7.4 Beyond insight databases
blocks.zh: 7.4 超越洞察力数据库

blocks.en: There are multiple recent works that build databases of insights and use a search system to insert them in the prompt when a similar task comes up ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Nasvytis et al., 2026 ) . We see this as the most promising path when using untrainable (frontier) models. However, if there is the possibility to train the model (or even just an adapter), we believe training insights into the model via ℒ SFT \mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}} might be the simpler approach. This is because the backpropagation of the insight automatically generalizes it to similar tasks, and the model applies the insights when needed automatically, to the extent that is necessary. This removes the need for a dedicated (and often complex) retrieval system. Of course, performance of this needs to be benchmarked, which we leave as future work.
blocks.zh: 最近有多种作品建立洞察力数据库,并在出现类似任务时使用搜索系统插入(Zhang等人,2026a); Tang et al., 2026; Nasvytis et al., 2026 ). 我们认为,在使用无法训练的(边境)模式时,这是最有希望的道路。 然而,如果有可能训练模型(甚至只是一个适配器),我们认为通过L SFT\mathcal{L}_{\text{SFT}}}对模型的训练洞察可能是比较简单的方法. 这是因为洞察力的反向传播会自动将其概括到类似的任务中,模型在必要的时候会自动应用洞察力,以至必要. 这就不再需要专用的(而且往往是复杂的)检索系统。 当然,这项工作的绩效需要作为基准,我们把它作为今后的工作。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion and outlook
blocks.zh: 8 结论和展望

blocks.en: This paper is a first demonstration that directly backpropagating high-level, compacted insights into a policy, conditioned only on the task and not on the rollout, enables the policy to internalize, generalize, and apply these insights. We focus on using this as an auxiliary objective during a self-improvement RLVR loop, which enables breaking through the learning barrier in otherwise learning-signal-starved Pass@128=0 tasks. But we also find that it can be used as a training signal on its own, without requiring full rollouts to backpropagate on.
blocks.zh: 本文是第一个直接支持高层次、紧凑的见解、只以任务为条件而不以推出政策为条件的演示,使政策能够内化、概括和运用这些见解。 我们注重在自修的 RLVR 环路中将此作为辅助目标,这样就可以突破学习障碍,否则学习-信号-饥饿通道@128=0任务. 但我们也发现它可以自己用作训练信号,而不要求全面推出后卫。

blocks.en: This gives rise to multiple next questions: First, how exactly is the knowledge generalized through the backpropagation? We hypothesize this has to do with the smoothness of the parameters of a (sufficiently pretrained) model, implicitly routing the knowledge not just naively to the literal task and literal format of task → \rightarrow insight, but to any semantically similar task and output format, including generating a full rollout. Second, where are the limits of this paradigm? Tool-calling might be special in its hard to find but easy to apply insights. We expect that training only on compressed insights is not feasible in all domains, especially in domains where the policy possesses too little pretraining capabilities for the smoothness to emerge, or domains where tasks are so specific that strong enough insights are not applicable to similar problems. Third, which other forms of training become possible if we remove the need for full rollouts? We expect that training only on the insights, without the concrete example, can enable federated learning at scale, learning from feedback or skills written by humans, and learning from summaries of very long rollouts that possibly contain erroneous detours, as is common in self-improvement scenarios.
blocks.zh: 这引起了多个接下来的问题: 首先,通过反向传播,知识是如何被普遍化的? 我们假设,这与(经过充分训练的)模型参数的光滑性有关,含蓄地使知识不仅天真地与任务字面上的任务和字面上的格式有关,而且与任何相似的任务和产出格式有关,包括全面推出。 第二,这种模式的局限性在哪里? 工具调用在难以找到但易于应用的见解方面可能很特殊。 我们期望,仅仅就压缩的见解进行培训并非在所有领域都可行,特别是在政策没有多少培训前能力,无法顺利地出现的领域,或任务如此具体、足够深刻的见解不适用于类似问题的领域。 第三,如果我们不再需要全面展开培训,哪些其他形式的培训是可能的? 我们期望,只有在没有具体实例的情况下进行洞察力培训,才能在规模上进行联邦式学习,学习人类的反馈或技能,并学习可能包含错误方向的非常长的推广总结,这在自我改进设想中是常见的。

blocks.en: A.1 Insight generation
blocks.zh: A.1 透视生成

blocks.en: We let the policy generate its own insight after each rollout. After each rollout that the verifier code flags as failed, we take the full rollout chat, and insert it inside a judge prompt in a new context. We use a new conversation rather than continuing the previous chat to reduce contextual drag ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . As shown in the prompt below, we insert task, agent actions, observations (shortened if exceedingly long), and unit test outputs by the verifier code.
blocks.zh: 我们让该政策在每次推出之后产生自己的见解。 在每次推出验证器代码标记失败后, 我们进行全面推出聊天, 并插入到法官的提示中, 以新的背景。 我们使用新的对话,而不是继续之前的聊天,以减少背景拖曳(Cheng等人,2026年)。 如下面的提示所示,我们插入任务、代理动作、观察(缩短或超长)和单位测试输出。

blocks.en: We let the agent first think (with a budget of 4096 tokens), then produce a summary, (longer) feedback, a step in which the agent went wrong, a correction, and finally a one-sentence insight. We extract this via json parsing and only use the final one-sentence insight in the paper, the remainder is mostly an autoregressive crux to increase test-time compute before providing the insight. We find that providing the long summary and feedback as hint for the next rollout does not outperform in Section 6 . In fact, it reduces performance, likely because one-sentence insights are more general and internalizing them via backpropagation can transfer the knowledge to other similar tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们让代理商首先思考(预算为4096令牌),然后产生总结,(延长)反馈,这是代理商出错的一步,修正,最后是一判决的洞察力. 我们通过Json解析来提取, 并且只使用论文中最后的一判决洞察力, 其余的主要是一个自动递归的十字架, 在提供洞察力之前增加测试时间计算。 我们发现,提供长篇摘要和反馈作为下次推出的提示,没有超过第6节。 事实上,它降低了性能,可能是因为一判决的见解比较笼统,通过反向传播将其内化,可以将知识转移到其他类似的任务上.

blocks.en: Prompt 1: Prompt for the insight generation. Note that we let the agent first think, and then generate summary, feedback, wrong step ID, and corrected step, before giving the actual insight. Only the actual insight (in the form of a TL;DR sentence) is used in the majority of the paper, the remainder is generated autoregressively in order to increase accuracy. You are a verifier that is given a step-by-step solution of an agent that has to perform some on-device task for the following task: ... Here is the step-by-step solution that the agent proposed. At each step, it proposed some code to retrieve information or execute actions, then gets an observation from the environment that executed that code on the simulated device. ============================== AGENT ROLLOUT ============================== Step 1: ... Observation 1: ... Step 2: ... ============================== END OF AGENT ROLLOUT ============================== The verifier code ran and returned this output: Rollout FAILED the following verifier tests: Playlist has length 2712 seconds but must be >= 3215 seconds. As a verifier, you now have to produce a json with FIVE parts: 1) Summarize the agent attempt, 2) Give feedback, 3) Give the step at which it went wrong, 4) Provide the corrected code for that step, 5) Give a one-sentence TL;DR hint. 1) Summarize the attempt - Give a summary of roughly one paragraph that describes what the agent did. - You can skip very generic code like API lookups or logins. - Focus on what the agent searched for and what it edited. - Also mention what the final answer of the agent was, or which items it changed on device exactly. - Do NOT consider the failed tests yet, if this was a failed rollout. - Do NOT critique yet, just summarize. 2) Give feedback - For successful rollouts, just return an empty string. - For failed rollouts, look at all failed tests. - Write a paragraph on what went wrong in the rollout. - Do NOT reveal what the ground-truth values are (private_data.* and all numbers that are on the right in the unit test asserts). You can reveal what the agent values were (the left values) if it helps explain the error. - Try to point out where exactly in the code the error is. Stop at the FIRST thing that went wrong. - Make it independent of the agent rollout, do NOT assume that the rollout will be shown along with your feedback. 3) Give the step at which it went wrong - Return the ID of the step where the agent produced wrong code. - If you cannot identify a specific step, output -1. 4) Provide the corrected code for that step - Return ONLY the python code that the agent should have written for the wrong step in place of what it actually wrote. Not the prior steps, not the following steps. - The code should be runnable as a drop-in replacement for the buggy step’s code. - Do NOT include explanatory prose inside the code; use code-comments only if essential. - Do NOT reveal ground-truth values (private_data.* / unit-test RHS). If a value is unknown, query it via the API instead of hard-coding. - If the rollout was correct or you cannot identify a specific wrong step, return an empty string. 5) Give a one-sentence TL;DR hint - After creating all the previous four parts, output a single-sentence hint on what went wrong. - Keep it to ONE sentence, plain language, no code. - This should be a concise pointer the agent can act on (e.g. "You created the list but gave it the wrong name."). - For successful rollouts, just return an empty string. - Do NOT reveal ground-truth values (private_data.* / unit-test RHS). Output your answer in a JSON. Do NOT output any text except the JSON. The format should be: { "summary": "...", "feedback": "...", "wrong_step_id": "integer", "corrected_step": "...", "hint": "..." }
blocks.zh: 即时1:即时为洞察力一代. 注意我们让代理先思考,然后生成摘要,反馈,错误的步骤ID,以及纠正步骤,然后给出实际的见解. 只有实际的洞察力(以TL;DR句的形式)在大多数论文中使用,其余部分是自动生成,以提高准确性. 您是被赋予一个代理人的逐个解决方案的核查者,该代理人必须为以下任务执行一些在线检测任务:. 以下是代理商提出的逐步解决方案. 在每一步,它都提出一些代码来获取信息或执行动作,然后从在模拟设备上执行该代码的环境那里得到一个观测. ============================== 自动摇摆 ============================== 步骤1:... 观察1:... 步骤2:... ============================== (原始内容存档于2018-09-21) (英语). Enter rollow ============================== 校验码运行并返回此输出 : 推出下列核查测试失败: 播放列表的长度为2712秒,但必须是QQ 3215秒. 作为一名核查员,你现在必须制作一个带有五部分的json: (1) 总结代理人的企图, 2)给出反馈,3)给出它出错的一步,4)提供该步骤的更正代码,5)给出一个一刑的TL;DR提示. 1) 总结尝试 - 大致概述一款描述代理人所作所为. - 你可以跳过 API 搜索或登录等非常通用的代码. - 专注于特工搜索什么和编辑什么。 - 还要说明代理的最后答案是什么,或者设备上究竟有什么变化。 - 不要考虑失败的测试, 如果这是一个失败的推出。 - 不要批评,只是总结一下。 2)给出反馈 - 对于成功推出,只需返回一个空字符串. - 对于失败的推出, 看看所有失败的测试。 - 写一个段落 关于什么出了错在推出。 - 不要披露地面真实值(私有数据* 和单位测试中右侧的所有数字)。 如果您能帮助解释错误, 您可以显示代理值( 左值) 。 - 试着指出错误在代码中的确切位置。 停止第一 事情出错。 - 让它独立于代理推出, 不要假设推出将与你的反馈一起显示。 3) 给它出错的一步 - 返回代理生成错误代码的一步的ID. - 如果您无法识别特定步骤, 输出 - 1 。 4) 提供该步骤的校正代码 - 仅返回该代理人应为错误步骤所写的蟒蛇代码,以代替其实际写的东西。 - 不是前几个步骤,也不是以下步骤。 代码应该可以作为buggy 步骤代码的倒置替代 。 - 代码中不包括解释性说明;仅在必要的情况下使用代码注释。 - 不要显示地面真实值(私人数据.*/单位测试RHS)。 如果一个值未知,请通过API而不是硬编码查询. - 如果推出正确,或者无法识别一个特定的错误步骤,则返回一个空字符串。 5)给出一个一刑的TL;DR提示 - 在创建了前四部分后,输出一个单一的一刑的提示,说明出了什么错误. - 保持一句话,普通的语言,没有代码。 这应该是代理机可以操作的简洁指针(例如"您创建了列表但给出了错误的名称"). - 对于成功推出,只需返回一个空弦。 - 不要显示地面真实值(私人数据.*/单位测试RHS)。 以JSON方式提供答案。 除 JSON 外, 不要输出任何文本 。 格式应为:{"总结":"......,"回馈":"......,"错误_步骤_id":"整","修正_步骤":"......,"int":"......]]

A.2 Insight conditioning
blocks.zh: A.2 透视条件

blocks.en: Insight conditioning is triggered if there is at least one insights from a previous failure in the current batch (and thus task) and the running average success rate of the batch is ≤ 50 % \leq 50\% . We collect all one-sentence insights generated so far in this batch. If the task has already been attempted in an earlier RL update phase, we do not include those insights. As shown in Figure 1 , each insight is inserted as a single user message after the task and before the start of the next rollout. We do not insert the entire previous attempt / chat history, because we found this to introduce contextual drag.
blocks.zh: 如果对当前批次(因此也是任务)中之前的失败至少有一个洞察力,且批次运行平均成功率为~~50%\leq 50~~~,则触发透视调节. 我们收集了迄今为止这批判决中得出的所有单一判决见解。 如果在较早的更新阶段已经试图完成这项任务,我们并不包括这些见解。 如图1所示,每个洞见在任务完成后和下一次推出开始前作为单一用户信息插入. 我们不插入之前的整个尝试/ 聊天历史, 因为我们发现这引入了上下文拖曳 。

blocks.en: We track which rollouts are conditioned on insight and which are not, in order to compute the deconfounded metrics in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们追踪哪些推出取决于洞察力,哪些不是,以便计算附录D中的解构指标。

blocks.en: A.3 Loss details
blocks.zh: A.3 损失详情

blocks.en: In this section, we describe some changes in the loss function and architecture compared to standard GRPO. We accumulated these changes to improve the performance of the GRPO baseline on Appworld-train. We then use them for all methods for fairness (while possibly giving the baseline a slight advantage due to having tuned the changes towards it, not towards our own method).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了与标准GRPO相比,损失函数和架构的一些变化. 我们积累了这些变化,以改善Appworld-train上的GPRO基线的性能. 然后,我们用它们来做一切公平的方法(可能因为调整了基准,而不是我们自己的方法而使基准略为有利)。

blocks.en: A.3.1 Changes taken over from DAPO
blocks.zh: 见A.3.1。 从DAPO接管的变动

blocks.en: We utilize changes from literature to improve stability and performance.
blocks.zh: 我们利用文学上的变化来改善稳定和业绩。

blocks.en: KL Divergence. Just like DAPO ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , we do not regularize the policy to stay close to the original policy via a KL divergence. We observe that even without KL divergence, the model does not degenerate.
blocks.zh: KL差异报. 与DAPO(Yu等人,2026年)一样,我们没有通过KL分歧来规范与原政策保持距离的政策。 我们注意到,即使没有KL差异,模型也不会退化。

blocks.en: Token-level policy gradients. DAPO averages the losses on the outside of the sums, rather than within each rollout, so that tokens in shorter rollouts to not obtain a higher implicit weight than tokens in longer rollouts. We do the same.
blocks.zh: 肯式政策梯度。 DAPO对金额外的损失进行平均计算,而不是在每次推出中进行平均计算,这样,在推出时间较短的版本中,代币不会比在较长的版本中代币获得更高的隐含重量. 我们也是

blocks.en: Removing the standard deviation. Dr. GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025b ) removes the division by the standard deviation in the standard GRPO advantage function. We also observe improvements when removing it. On very hard tasks, where most samples have a negative gradient, the low standard deviation would otherwise increase the gradients, which increases entropy and destabilizes the model.
blocks.zh: 删除标准偏差 。 Dr. GRPO(Liu et al., 2025b)通过标准GRPO优势功能中的标准偏差去除划分. 我们还看到,在去除地雷时有所改进。 在非常艰巨的任务上,在大多数样本有负梯度的情况下,低标准偏差会增加梯度,这增加了 en度,破坏了模型的稳定.

blocks.en: A.3.2 Positive-ratio filtering
blocks.zh: A.3.2 正比过滤

blocks.en:
We also add a new trick we call positive-ratio filtering.
In early experiments with the GRPO baseline, we often observed instability due to entropy explosion, followed by policy collapse. We find that on the very hard tasks we train on in our self-improvement setting, the majority of GRPO rewards are negative, thus driving the model to reduce the likelihoods of its known modes and increase its entropy. This entropy increase appears to be rather blind; it pushes the policy away from its current knowledge, but towards no new modes, thus destabilizing training.
blocks.zh:
我们还增加了一种新伎俩,我们称之为正比过滤。
在早期使用GRPO基线的实验中,我们经常观察到由于 en爆炸导致的不稳定,随后政策崩溃. 我们发现,在我们自我改善环境中所训练的非常艰巨的任务中,GRPO的奖励大多是负面的,从而驱使模型降低已知模式的可能性并增加其 en. 这种肽类增长似乎相当盲目;它把政策从目前的知识中推开,但没有转向新的模式,从而破坏培训的稳定。

blocks.en:
Thus, after calculating the advantages of each rollout (and filtering out zero-advantage batches), we filter rollouts to ensure that 75 % 75\% have a positive reward.
This trick is primarily intended to stabilize the GRPO baseline. Since it is part of our ℒ GRPO \mathcal{L}_{\text{GRPO}} loss, it is also active for RLTL;DR (and the SGE baseline). However, we find that there it is not so critical, since the insight conditioning and SFT loss already lead to many positive-advantage rollouts.
blocks.zh:
因此,在计算每次推出的好处(并过滤出零优势批次)后,我们过滤推出以确保75%的75QQ得到积极的奖励。
这一伎俩主要是为了稳定GRPO基线. 由于它是我们L GRPO\ mathcal{L}_{\Text{GRPO}损失的一部分,它也活跃于RLTL;DR(和SGE基线). 然而,我们发现,这并非如此关键,因为洞察力条件和SFT损失已经导致许多积极有利因素的推出。

blocks.en: A.4 Train hyperparameters
blocks.zh: A.4 火车超参数

blocks.en: Hyperparameters for our train runs are given in Table 4 . We use different hyperparameters for Leetcode and Appworld because Leetcode does a single, long message per task. We deactivate think mode on Leetcode, because on the very hard problems, think mode ran out of token budget. The average number of attempts per task is higher than the minimum number because we use an aynchronous rollout collection, where some workers may take longer to fill their minimum number of attempts (due to working on harder tasks), while other workers continue collecting rollouts. Note also that we follow Qwen’s train format, i.e., always only the current action has think tokens in context, previous steps have no think traces. This means that at backprop time, by "minibatch size" we mean a single step (think trace + action), not a full rollout.
blocks.zh: 我们列车运行的超参数见表4。 我们对Letcode和Appworld使用不同的超参数,因为Letcode每个任务都执行一个单长的信息. 我们取消了Letcode上的思维模式, 因为对于非常困难的问题, 思维模式已经用完了。 每项任务的平均尝试次数比最低次数要多,因为我们使用同步的推广收集,一些工人可能需要更长的时间来填补其最低的尝试次数(因为从事更艰巨的工作),而其他工人则继续收集推广. 请注意, 我们遵循 Quen 的列车格式, 即: 总是只有当前动作在上下文中具有思考符号, 这意味着在后置时间,通过"小批量尺寸",我们的意思是单步(思考痕量+动作),而不是全面推出.

blocks.en: All experiments were run on nodes of 8xB200 GPUs, and took 1-4 days of compute each.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在8xB200GPU的节点上运行的,每个节点需要1-4天的计算.

blocks.en: A.5 Fixing Qwen’s tendency to overthink on hard Leetcode problems
blocks.zh: A.5 纠正Quen过度思考硬利特码问题的倾向

blocks.en: On Leetcode, we notice that Qwen 3.5 9B tends to produce overly long solutions and run out of even very high token budgets of 16k without producing a codeblock. This behavior remains regardless of whether we deactivate thinking (in which case it would reason in the text block), or deactivate thinking and directly open a code block (in which case it would reason in code comments). This only happens on very hard (Pass@128=0) Leetcode tasks, on easier problems it produces code blocks as expected.
blocks.zh: 在Letcode上,我们注意到,Quen 3.5 9B倾向于产生过长的解决方案,并耗尽即使是非常高的16k的预算,而没有产生代码块. 这种行为不管我们是否解除思维(在文本块中它会引起),还是解除思维并直接打开一个代码块(在代码注释中它会引起),都仍然存在. 这只在非常硬(Pass@128=0)的Letcode任务上发生,在它像预期的那样产生代码块的较容易的问题上发生.

blocks.en: Training RLTL;DR on this split was somewhat trivial; the feedback generator simply always responded to shorten the answer, until (with enough insights of this in the context) the model would comply. We thus seeked out to fix this problem first, so that the insight generation would be more challenging.
blocks.zh: 培训RLTL;关于这种拆分的DR有点微不足道;反馈生成器只是总是对缩短答案作出反应,直到(在上下文中对此有足够的见解)该模型将符合。 因此,我们力求首先解决这个问题,以便有远见的一代人更具挑战性。

blocks.en: We thus first sample a Pass@128=0 split and GRPO train on it for 100k steps. GRPO quickly picks up the simple first-order statistic that long rollouts have low reward. The final checkpoint almost never runs out of the 16k token budget anymore. We use this checkpoint to start training from on Leetcode experiments in this paper, and the 123 frontier-difficult Leetcode tasks are tasks where this checkpoint still has Pass@128=0.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们首先抽取一辆Pass@128=0分机和GRPO列车,用于100k步. GRPO迅速拿起简单的一阶统计,即长期推出的奖励低. 最后的检查站 几乎永远没有用完 16k的象征性预算。 我们利用这个检查站开始从本文中的Letcode实验开始训练,123个边疆困难的Letcode任务就是这个检查站仍然有Pass@128=0.

blocks.en: Appendix B Reproducing the RLTL;DR Implementation
blocks.zh: 附录B 复制RLTL;DR 执行

blocks.en: Reproducing our approach takes three steps. We provide literal-format examples in this paper to verify the implementation.
blocks.zh: 复制我们的方法需要三个步骤。 我们在本文件中提供了文字形式的例子,以核实执行情况。

blocks.en: First, after each rollout, the agent needs to be called again in a new context/chat with the judge prompt (this is important to prevent context drag / bias). This prompt should look as in Section A.1 , and we use up to 4096 think and 4096 action tokens for this generation. The output should be a json dict, and the TL;DR insight can be extracted from it programmatically.
blocks.zh: 首先,每次推出后,代理人需要在法官的提示下在新的上下文/聊天中再次被调用(这对于防止上下文拖动/偏差很重要). 这个提示应该像A.1节那样看,我们为这一代人使用了多达4096种想法和4096种动作符号。 产出应当是json dict, 和 TL; DR 的洞察力可以通过程序从中提取.

blocks.en: Second, the insight needs to be inserted into context the next time we make a rollout, if the current batch’s avg success rate is ≤ 50 % \leq 50\% . The insights should be inserted as user messages after the task, Figure 1 gives the exact format including special tokens (only omitting newlines). We found the construction of this context to be a frequent error source and encourage to output the literal context sent to the model during debugging or even as an assert statement during inference.
blocks.zh: 第二,下次我们推出时需要将洞察力融入背景,如果目前的批量成功率为 ~ 50%\leq 50\ 。 图1给出了包括特殊符号(仅省略新行)在内的准确格式。 我们发现这种上下文的构建是一个频繁的错误源,并鼓励在调试时输出发送给模型的文字上下文,甚至作为推论时的断言语句.

blocks.en: Third, in the backpropagation phase of the RL updater, the masks on the insight tokens need to be flipped to backpropagate on the insight tokens. This should look exactly like the example in Section 3.3 . Note that when we have multiple insights, we flip the masks of all of them simultaneously, so later insights are learned conditionally on previous ones. This is largely for simplicity (in order to not require constructing new contexts and thus forward computations).
blocks.zh: 第三,在RL更新器的后传阶段,洞见符号上的口罩需要翻转到洞见符号上的后传. 这应与第3.3节的例子完全相同。 请注意,当我们有多种见解时,我们同时翻开所有这些观念的面具,所以以后的见解是有条件地根据以前的见解来学习的. 这主要是为了简单(以便不需要构建新的环境,从而进行前瞻性计算)。

blocks.en: With these three implementations checked, we encourage to first verify that insights work in the given domain by producing a plot like Figure 11 . Then, during training, we encourage to check that the insight advantage described in Section D.2 is > 0 >0 . Last, after training, we encourage to check the deconfounded success rate without insights in context as reported throughout this paper and as described in Section D.1 .
blocks.zh: 在检查这三项执行之后,我们鼓励首先通过制作像图11那样的图案来核实在特定领域的见解工作。 然后,在培训期间,我们鼓励检查D.2节所述的洞察优势是否 > 0 > 0。 最后,在经过培训后,我们鼓励按照本文全文和D.1节所述,在没有洞察力的情况下检查无根据的成功率。

blocks.en: Appendix D How to evaluate without confounders
blocks.zh: 附录D 如何评价没有混淆者

blocks.en: RL training with insight in context, and also generally RL training, has many subtle confounders that can make some approaches look better or worse than others. In this section, we break down how we run evaluate to eliminate those confounders, both for standard RL metrics and for metrics that target the quality/strength of insights.
blocks.zh: 讲究背景的RL培训,以及一般的RL培训,有许多微妙的困惑者,可以使某些方法比其他方法看起来好或坏. 在本节中,我们分解了我们如何开展评估,以消除标准RL指标和针对见解质量/强度的衡量标准方面的混乱因素。

blocks.en: D.1 Deconfounded RL train and eval metrics
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 解密RL列车和 eval 度量衡

blocks.en: Pass@1. The perhaps most important metric in RL train curves and evaluation is the Pass@1, the average success rate across all tasks. There are two confounders here, worker throughput and insight conditioning.
blocks.zh: 传@1. RL列车曲线和评价中也许最重要的衡量标准是Pass@1,即所有任务的平均成功率. 这里有两个混血儿,工人的吞吐量和洞察力

blocks.en: Worker throughput is a problem that mostly arises in asynchronous RL training. In evaluation, we limit each task to be evaluated an exact amount of times (usually 8). But during training, we let workers collect rollouts for their assigned task until the slowest worker has collected its required minimum GRPO groupsize of 8 rollouts. This means that tasks have different amounts of rollouts, and usually easier tasks (that are solved faster) have more rollouts. Looking at the global average success rate during training is thus biased. We always report macro-averaged Pass@1 (and Pass@k), by first averaging success rates per task, and then across tasks.
blocks.zh: 工人吞吐量问题大多出现在同步的RL训练中. 在评价中,我们限制每项任务的确切评价次数(通常是8次). 但是在训练期间,我们让工人收集他们分配的任务,直到最慢的工人收集到所需的最低限度的GRPO组8个推广组。 这意味着任务有不同数量的展开,通常更容易的任务(被更快地解决)有较多的展开. 因此,在培训期间审视全球平均成功率是有偏见的。 我们总是报告宏观平均的Pass@1(和Pass@k),首先报告每项任务的平均成功率,然后报告跨任务。

blocks.en: The second confounder comes from insight conditioning: Rollouts with insights in context are naturally higher-performing (otherwise the insights are broken). But insights are not available at test time, so the actual metric we care about is performance without insights in context. Thus, during training we calculate the above macro-average both on all rollouts and also only on rollouts that do not have insights in context. One complication to keep in mind here is that the macro average could become biased again if some tasks don’t have any rollouts without insights (usually, those are very hard tasks) or any rollouts with insights (very easy tasks). In our setup, this is not a problem, since the very first rollout per task is always without an insight, and so the macro-average is always over the same tasks. Lastly, we fix the ordering of tasks, allowing to compare across time and across approaches.
blocks.zh: 第二位解析者来自洞察性条件:在上下文中带有洞察性能的推出自然是更高的(否则洞察性能被打破). 但是在测试时间没有洞察力,所以我们所关心的实际衡量尺度是,在背景上没有洞察力的性能. 因此,在培训期间,我们计算出所有推出的宏观平均数,也只计算那些对背景没有见解的推出的宏观平均数。 这里要记住的一个复杂情况是,如果某些任务没有洞察力(通常是非常困难的任务)或任何洞察力(非常容易的任务)的洞察力(非常容易的任务),宏观平均值可能再次出现偏差。 在我们的设置中,这不是一个问题,因为每次任务的第一个展开总是没有洞察力,所以宏观平均总是在相同的任务之上. 最后,我们确定任务的顺序,以便进行跨时间和跨方法的比较。

blocks.en: Pass@k. Pass@k is an important metric to judge whether a task is within the capabilities of a model, at least with some probability. However, k k is not constant, neither across tasks nor across different train runs, due to the varying worker throughput in async rollout collection we described above. So some tasks might have k = 8 k=8 and others k = 23 k=23 , and Pass@23 will naturally be higher than Pass@8.
blocks.zh: 传球@k. Pass@k是判断一项任务是否在模型能力范围内,至少有一定的概率的重要衡量标准. 然而,kk不是恒定的,无论是跨任务还是跨不同列车运行,因为上文我们提到的工人在Aync推出集中的吞吐量各不相同。 所以有些任务可能有k=8k=8,其他k=23k=23,而Pass@23自然会高于Pass@8.

blocks.en: We thus track two metrics: Pass@8 (constant) and Pass@ k k (all rollouts per task). This is because both serve different purposes. Pass@8 allows to compare the capabilities of models across different RL runs. Pass@k allows to judge the learning dynamics of a single RL run, to understand if the model still has some learning (or more precisely, exploitation) potential, because there is a reasonable gap between Pass@1 and Pass@k, or whether one needs to lean more into exploration, because Pass@k is too low to begin with. In the main paper, we report whichever metric makes more sense in the given context and comment explicitly on the choice.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们追踪两个指标:Pass@8(恒定)和Pass@kk(每个任务全部推出)。 这是因为两者的目的不同。 Pass@8可以比较不同RL运行的模型能力. Pass@k允许判断单个RL运行的学习动态,可以理解模型是否有一定的学习潜力(或更精确地说,开发潜力),因为Pass@1和Pass@k之间有合理的差距,或者人们是否需要更靠在探索中,因为Pass@k太低而无法开始. 在主要文件中,我们报告在特定背景下更合理的衡量标准,并明确评论选择。

blocks.en: Choice of the x x -axis. Especially in train curves, one needs to decide what to plot metrics against on the x-axis. The same holds for after how much train budget one should end training. Recently, many papers have been using the number of updates (as in the back-and-forth between rollout collection and agent update phases). However, we argue this is largely confounded: Consider one run that just samples more rollouts per task, be it by construction by directly or indirectly increasing the GRPO groupsize, or again due to the async worker throughputs. It will have more rollouts to backpropagate on, and higher chances of finding solutions due to the higher Pass@k. This would go completely undetected if only looking at the number of update phases on the x x -axis. Another issue is that some policies might sample longer rollouts with more environment steps, again providing more learning signal.
blocks.zh: 选择 xx - 轴 。 特别是在火车曲线上,人们需要决定在X轴上绘制什么指标。 在火车预算结束培训之后,情况也是如此。 最近,许多论文一直在使用更新次数(如推出收集阶段和代理更新阶段之间的前后更新). 然而,我们争辩说,这在很大程度上是令人困惑的: 考虑一次运行,只要对每个任务进行更多推广的样本,无论是通过直接或间接增加GRPO组别,还是再次由于合成工人的吞吐量。 它将有更多的启动软件,以提供后盾,而且由于Pass@k较高,找到解决方案的机会会增加。 如果只查看xx轴上更新阶段的数目,则将完全不被发现。 另一个问题是,有些政策可能以更多的环境步骤对较长时间的推出进行抽样,再次提供更多的学习信号。

blocks.en: We argue that better candidates for the x x -axis are the number of steps taken in the environment (in chat setups, that is the number of messages sent), the number of tokens generated, or the overall walltime. In our setup, we choose the number of steps taken in the environment, since walltime differs slightly by hardware and occasional vllm crashes. We track all of these metrics though as secondary metrics and plot them against one another. This makes it easy to detect if one RL run differs considerably from another RL run, so that one can investigate whether its advantage comes purely from this, and how to normalize or restrict it back to allow unconfounded comparisons across runs. For example, we make sure to keep group sizes (rollouts per task) comparably distributed across runs.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,xx轴的更好候选人是环境(在聊天设置中,即发送信件的数量)中的步骤数量,生成的符号数量,或者整个墙壁时间. 在我们的设置中,我们选择了在环境中所采取步骤的数量,因为墙上的时间因硬件和偶尔的vllm碰撞而略有不同. 我们追踪所有这些度量衡,尽管是二级度量衡, 并把它们相互夹击。 这使得很容易发现一个RL运行是否与另一个RL运行有很大差异,这样人们就可以调查其优势是否纯粹来自此,以及如何使其正常化或限制返回以允许无根据的跨运行比较. 例如,我们确保各组的大小(每个任务滚动)在分布上可以比较。

blocks.en: Other secondary metrics. Besides these main metrics, we also track the policy’s entropy (as a first warning sign of instability), its PPO clip rate when online logits start differing strongly from the offline policies logits (indicating too high effective learning rate), and its PPO clip rate on the very first batch in update phases, before any updates (indicating off-policy drift if beyond pure bfloat16 noise, for example when the vllm collection sampler produces vastly different logits than the logits that are recalculated during the update phase). We do not report these metrics in this paper, but track them to verify the stability of training and best possible performance of all approaches and baselines.
blocks.zh: 其他二级衡量标准。 除了这些主要的衡量标准之外,我们还跟踪政策的entropy(作为不稳定性的第一个警告信号),当在线登录开始与离线政策登录(表明学习率太高)有很大差异时的PPO剪辑率,以及更新阶段第一批的PPO剪辑率(表明如果超出纯bfloat16噪声,则在政策外的漂移,例如当vllm采集取样器产生与更新阶段重新计算的日志大不相同的日志时)。 我们不在本文件中报告这些衡量标准,而是追踪这些指标,以核实培训的稳定性以及所有办法和基线的最佳业绩。

blocks.en: D.2 Gauging insight strength
blocks.zh: D.2 判断力

blocks.en: A good insight should help find a solution on the next try, but it should also not be so strong that it makes the task trivial and collapses learning signal. We thus track multiple metrics to judge the quality of insights.
blocks.zh: 良好的洞察力应该有助于在下一次尝试中找到一个解决方案,但是它也不应该那么强大,以至于使得任务变得微不足道,并且会崩溃的学习信号. 因此,我们追踪多种衡量标准,以判断见解的质量。

blocks.en: Insight advantage. The most straight-forward metric is to compare the average success rate on rollouts with and without insights. This poses the same caveats as described above for Pass@1: These metrics should be macro-averaged first within and then across tasks (because different tasks might have different amounts of insights), and one needs to make sure that this is done for the same set of tasks (easy tasks might not have any rollouts with insights, depending on how one decides to give insights). After controlling for both of these confounders, the Pass@1 with insights minus the Pass@1 without insights, on all tasks that have both rollouts with and without insights, gives the average insight advantage. This estimate of how much an insight increases the probability of finding a solution to the problem should always stay > 0 >0 , and ideally with quite some margin, but may reduce to 0 as training progresses.
blocks.zh: 透视优势. 最直接的衡量标准是比较推出时的平均成功率与没有深刻见解的情况。 这与上述出入证1的警告相同: 这些衡量标准应首先在任务内部进行宏观平均,然后在任务之间进行宏观平均(因为不同的任务可能有不同程度的见解),并且需要确保这样做是为了同样的一套任务(容易的任务可能没有任何有见解的推广,取决于人们如何决定给予见解)。 在控制了这两个混沌者之后,有洞察力的Pass@1减去没有洞察力的Pass@1, 对所有既具有洞察力又没有洞察力的任务, 都提供了一般洞察力优势。 这种对深入了解的程度的估计可以增加找到问题解决办法的概率,这种可能性应始终维持在 > 0 > 0,最好有相当的幅度,但随着培训的进展,可能减少到0。

blocks.en: Insight Pass@k. In addition to the average insight advantage, we also report the Pass@2 , … , ,\dotsc, Pass@16 when sampling with insights in context (the Pass@1 being without any insights because none has been generated yet). We find that tracking this even on the off-the-shelf policy before any training often predicts how well the training will respond to insights.
blocks.zh: 透视通道@k. 除了一般的洞察优势外,我们还报告Pass@2,.,.,\dotsc,Pass@16,用上下文的洞察力取样时(Pass@1没有任何洞察力,因为还没有产生任何洞察力). 我们发现,即使在现成政策中跟踪这一点,在任何培训之前,往往会预测培训对见解的反应如何。

blocks.en: Insight too-easy ratio. It can, however, be that an insight makes a task too easy to solve. The extreme case here would be that an insight just gives the full solution. We thus also track in how many tasks that have rollouts conditioned on insights all rollouts conditioned on insights are correct. This collapses the learning signal of GRPO training, and indicates that insights should be less revealing. It cannot be prevented that this occasionally happens, but we aim to keep this ratio below 20%.
blocks.zh: 透视太易率. 然而,一个洞察力可能使一项任务过于容易解决。 这里的极端情况是,洞察力只是提供了充分的解决办法。 因此,我们还跟踪了以见解为条件展开的多少任务,以见解为条件展开的所有任务是正确的。 这打破了GPRO培训的学习信号,表明洞察力应该不那么能说明问题。 无法防止这种情况偶尔发生,但我们的目标是将这一比率保持在20%以下。

blocks.en: However, for the SFT loss on insights it does not matter whether insights make tasks too easy, so this insight too-easy ratio is more important in literature that uses only a GRPO loss, and less important for us than the insight advantage metric.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于SFT在洞察力上的损失,对于洞察力是否使任务变得太容易无关紧要,所以这种洞察力过于容易的比例在仅仅使用GRPO损失的文献中更为重要,对我们来说比洞察力优势衡量标准更重要.

blocks.en: Insight too-hard ratio. On the flipside, insights can be not helpful (or even misleading). To capture this, we track on how many tasks, that have rollouts conditioned on insights, none of the insight-conditioned rollouts are correct. This indicates that insights should be made stronger, for example by giving the insight-generator access to the verifier code to make the insight more precise. It is hard to give a strict target value here, since especially on challenging tasks we expect that a big share of tasks is unsolvable even with the occasional insight, but we aim to use insights that keep this ratio below 50%.
blocks.zh: 透视太硬比例. 在侧面,洞察力可能无济于事(甚至误导性). 为了抓住这一点,我们追踪了有多少任务,这些任务都以洞察力为条件展开,但洞察力和洞察力的洞察力的洞察力都没有正确。 这表明,应使见解更加明确,例如,使见解产生者能够查阅核查者代码,使见解更加准确。 很难给出一个严格的目标值,因为特别是在挑战性的任务上,我们期望,即使偶尔有洞察力,也无法解决很大一部分任务,但我们的目标是利用将这一比率保持在50%以下的洞察力。

blocks.en: Insight generalization. The four previous metrics only track how much an insight helps on the task that the insight was generated for. However, the ideal metric would be to track "how much does this insight help teach the model". Unfortunately, this metric is close to intractable, unless one can afford to run an evaluation on heldout data after every train step. Instead, train curves (at least on SAPI) serve as a natural heldout evaluation on a rolling base: At iteration i i , we collect rollouts on tasks that have never been seen on iteration 1 , … , i − 1 1,\dots,i-1 , based on the policy that has been trained with rollouts and insights from iterations i , … , i − 1 i,\dotsc,i-1 . Then we update on these tasks and move to the next tasks. Naturally, all eval metrics (like Pass@1) are calculated before the update. The steepness of the curve indirectly reveals how much the training with insights generalizes to general knowledge about how to solve tasks. We aim to adhere to this principle by training on a large enough dataset, where we see each task only once before we update on it, like in SAPI. In smaller datasets like Appworld, we explicitly note in the main text at which point the training cycles through an epoch boundary, and report heldout performance at the end of training.
blocks.zh: 洞察通论. 前面四个衡量标准只跟踪了解如何有助于了解了解所产生的任务。 然而,理想的衡量标准是跟踪“这种洞察力帮助教导模型多少”。 不幸的是,这一衡量标准几乎是难以解决的,除非在每趟列车后都能够对搁置的数据进行评价。 列车曲线(至少是在SAPI上)在滚滚的基座上充当自然阻断评价: 我们收集了在第一版上从未见过的任务的推广, ... ...,i − 11,\dots,i-1, 根据政策, 已经训练了推广和从第二版的见解 i,...,i − 1 i,\dotsc,i-1。 然后,我们更新这些任务,并转入下一个任务。 自然,所有eval度量衡(如Pass@1)都是在更新前计算的. 曲线的陡峭性间接地揭示了有洞察力的训练能在多大程度上概括到如何解决任务的一般知识. 我们的目标是坚持这一原则,对一个足够大的数据集进行培训,在更新之前,我们只看到每项任务一次,例如在SAPI中。 在像Appworld这样的较小的数据集中,我们在正文中明确注意到训练周期通过一个划时代的界限,并在训练结束时报告被扣的性能.
